metric_definitions.definition: Fraction of scenarios where cross-resource dependencies are handled correctly.

metric_definitions.definition: Fraction of evidence-relevant scenarios where arbitration uses authoritative evidence.

metric_definitions.name: global_optimum_accuracy
metric_definitions.definition: Fraction of global-optimization scenarios where the lowest-cost viable option is chosen.

metric_definitions.name: human_review_calibration
